name: FTUE sound choice modal gates mute on first launch
description: bob is the FTUE user (gamesPlayed === 0), so the SOUND CHECK modal must be the first thing he sees. Covers both branches: PLAY WITHOUT SOUND must mute the game, PLAY WITH SOUND must leave it unmuted and start the title music. The modal is session-scoped, so a reload re-asks and lets us drive the second branch. Ends on the unmuted branch so bob is left in a sane state.

steps._comment: bob has gamesPlayed 0 -> isFtue true. carol has played, so she never sees this modal.
Force a real reload - HMR has served a stale client bundle in this repo before.
ASSERTION 1: the modal opens at start. showSoundChoice also requires audioPreferenceLoaded, so this covers the async user.init settling.
Visual check of the SOUND CHECK modal on first launch

steps.expression: (() => { const on = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-on]'); const off = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-off]'); return (on ? 'on:' + on.textContent.trim() : 'ON MISSING') + ' | ' + (off ? 'off:' + off.textContent.trim() : 'OFF MISSING'); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 2: 'no sound' mutes the game. aria-pressed mirrors the muted state in TitleStrip; this step fails if it stayed unmuted.
Let the setMuted mutation reach the server before we reload
Session-scoped modal re-asks on reload - that's how we reach branch B
Modal re-appears because bob is still FTUE

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); return b ? 'aria-pressed=' + b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') : 'no mute btn'; })()
steps._comment: Should read true - proves branch A's choice persisted server-side across the reload
Spy play() so we can prove the WITH SOUND branch actually starts title music at non-zero volume
steps.expression: (() => { if (window.__sndSpy) return 'already installed'; const spy = { played: [] }; window.__sndSpy = spy; const short = (s) => { try { return String(s||'').split('/').pop().split('?')[0]; } catch (e) { return String(s); } }; const nativePlay = HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play; HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play = function () { spy.played.push({ src: short(this.currentSrc || this.src), volume: Number(this.volume.toFixed(3)) }); return nativePlay.apply(this, arguments); }; return 'installed'; })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 3: 'with sound' leaves the game unmuted - and clears the muted state persisted by branch A.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__sndSpy; if (!s) return 'SPY MISSING'; if (!s.played.length) return 'NOTHING PLAYED'; return s.played.map(p => p.src + '@v' + p.volume).join(', '); })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 4 (reported): title music must play at non-zero volume. v0 here would mean the lazy-channel mute leak regressed.
Lobby is reachable after the choice - the modal is not blocking the app
Lobby after choosing PLAY WITH SOUND - mute icon should read unmuted
